subject: How to use postMessageAPI in “on premise” Shiny/Plotly app?

messages.author: f629d36425bfe74c
messages.subject: How to use postMessageAPI in “on premise” Shiny/Plotly app?
parts:
I am not sure if this is the proper forum for this question but thought I would try.  I have a on premise Shiny/Plotly Application.  I would like to use the Plotly PostMessageAPI defined here (https://github.com/plotly/postMessage-API) to modify a Plotly Chart on a Shiny dashboard after it is rendered.  All the examples of this show Codepen CSS/JS/HTML for "existing online" plotly charts.  

My question is, can I use this API if I have Plotly chart inside Shiny?  If so, is there any specific steps that may show how to do this. I looked into the shinyjs package as well here (https://github.com/daattali/shinyjs) and assumed I can use this as well but I am unsure how this would work with Shiny/Plotly.  

If anyone has any idea if this is possible or how to do it, it would be appreciated.  I would prefer to keep my Shiny ui.R code as is within the Shiny framework.
